note: Meitou only: when a town marks the squad as hunted (town heat 24+), the helper (Hunters.cs) has that town hire a bounty crew that travels to the squad and fights it. The crew is its own faction, hostile to the player only, so it attacks on sight; everyone else treats it like the Mercenary Guild it was hired from. Setting 'Bounty hunters (test)', off by default.

say: Your name's on a board back in town.
